resources.string: Park and disconnect from the head unit first. Updates are downloaded only from this repository\'s GitHub Releases; the hash, package name, version and signature are checked before installing, and the system still asks you to confirm. Nothing is uninstalled or cleared automatically.
Installing from this source is not allowed. The download is kept; nothing was uninstalled or changed.
Could not open the install-source setting. Allow it in system settings and try again.
Cancelling… the partial file is deleted once the network wait ends.
Could not open a browser. Visit %1$s manually.
Disconnect CarPlay and stop the CarWith self-test before updating, so the head unit is not interrupted.
No installable release with an APK and checksum was found on this channel. You can open the Releases page.
You already have the latest version on this channel: %1$s
This build is newer than the remote version %1$s; it will not be downgraded.
The remote version is %1$s with the same base version. This local build has no release tag, so the prerelease number cannot be compared; open the Releases page to update manually.
No release notes for this version
\n\nNote: this is a debug build. Release packages may be signed differently, and installation is refused if the signature does not match.
\n\nThe remote debug build cannot be replaced by the standard release APK; use the matching build channel.
Download complete. SHA-256, package name, version and signing certificate checks passed. Tap Install update; the system still asks you to confirm.
Handed to the system installer; confirm there. Cancelling the install does not clear this app\'s data.
Could not start the system installer. Open the Releases page and download manually.
The previous update task has not finished yet. Try again shortly.
The update failed. Check the network or free space and try again, or download manually from the Releases page.
Connection problem? Export a diagnostic report to send feedback; no computer or Shizuku needed.
Start CarWith to verify real H.264; disconnect other receivers first
For the CarWith EasyConn entry; another device must act as the peer
Mirror mode: injects head-unit touch gestures into the phone screen; does not read screen content
